home.title: Iván Méndez – Mobile & Web Developer | Kotlin, Swift & Flutter
home.summary: I design and build mobile applications for Android and iOS, from native Kotlin and Swift to cross-platform Flutter. With a product-focused mindset and a strong foundation in clean architecture, I deliver reliable, scalable software that solves real problems. I also build modern web applications when the project calls for it.
home.expertise1Desc: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, and the modern Android stack.
home.expertise2Desc: Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and Apple platform best practices.
home.expertise3Desc: Flutter & Dart for high-performance, single-codebase mobile apps.
home.expertise4Desc: Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, and scalable project structure.
home.expertise5Desc: Optimized builds, efficient rendering, and production-grade reliability.
home.expertise6Desc: Modern frontend with React, Astro, and responsive design systems.
home.workIntro: Real products shipped to production — from native mobile apps to cross-platform solutions used by real users.
home.ctaDesc: Looking for a mobile engineer or have a project in mind? I'd like to hear about it.
